proposal.architecture_precedent: aarch64 rows (ubuntu-24.04-arm, windows-11-arm) in wheels.yml; no ppc64le/s390x emulated precedent; riscv64 would need CIBW_ARCHS_LINUX=riscv64 with docker/setup-qemu-action on ubuntu-latest.
proposal.build_backend: setuptools>=77 + cython>=3.1; single C++ extension; no external native libs.
proposal.contribution_rules: CONTRIBUTING.md: open issues/PRs freely; no CLA, DCO or commit convention.
proposal.existing_riscv64_work: None upstream; downstream RISE build-spookyhash.yml/PR #1325 only.
proposal.fork_guards: None beyond upload_all gate on release event; no github.repository checks.
proposal.rationale: No blockers: pure portable C++/Cython, cibuildwheel (already used upstream) supports riscv64 manylinux_2_39 via QEMU, owner is active, accepts matrix PRs (#11,#14) with permissive CONTRIBUTING (no CLA/DCO). A workflow-only change to .github/workflows/wheels.yml adds a riscv64 job. Risks: no native riscv64 runners (QEMU slow; tests incl. hypothesis/numpy under emulation, numpy riscv64 wheels availability for tests may require sdist build, issue #12 test fragility), cibuildwheel riscv64 manylinux is experimental, upload_all consumes cibw-* artifacts so the artifact naming must match, and the owner's unknown intent. Fallback: build wheels only w/o tests or with limited test extras.
proposal.release_coverage: PyPI 2.1.2: macOS x86_64/arm64; manylinux_2_28/musllinux_1_2 x86_64+aarch64; win32/amd64/arm64; cp39-cp315 incl 3.14t/3.15t; no riscv64.
proposal.release_graph: wheels.yml: build_wheels (6-OS matrix, cibuildwheel v4.3.5) + make_sdist -> upload_all (environment pypi, trusted publishing) only on release published; triggers push main, PR, release, weekly cron. test.yml native tests.
proposal.target_matrix: cp39-cp315 incl. t variants manylinux_riscv64 (cibuildwheel defaults; downstream built cp312-cp314t); optionally musllinux_riscv64.

data.summary: spookyhash (buhanec/spookyhash, MIT, sole maintainer) is a Cython/C++ wrapper with no external native deps and no arch-specific code. Upstream PyPI 2.1.2 ships 82 wheels (macOS, manylinux/musllinux x86_64+aarch64, Windows) built by cibuildwheel@v4.3.5 in wheels.yml; riscv64 is absent. The RISE registry already has 2.1.1 riscv64 wheels (PR #1325). No upstream riscv64 issue, PR or discussion exists, no ecosystem report exists. A small bounded wheels.yml change adding an emulated cibuildwheel riscv64 leg is feasible.
